items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I was with Luke and them... When you went to see Luke and Margaret Stewart, then Luke was playing with Jonah and Dicky and Tom. They were playing in a club in Buffalo. ... The Vendome, a hotel.
